surface_label: Evidence / Boundaries (public proof closure is not claimed)

proof_surface_global_verdict.visible_card_copy: Evidence routes are inspectable and hash-bound; V010 does not claim external proof closure.
proof_surface_global_verdict.nonclaim_boundary: This verdict summarizes public inspectability and boundaries, not proof sufficiency.

proof_closure_policy: Rows with boundary/obligation status are excluded from proof-closed totals and must be presented as bounded evidence routes.

warning_code_taxonomy.label: Open-problem proof boundary
warning_code_taxonomy.applies_when: target row is famous, conjecture/problem/question-styled, or otherwise requires an elevated open-problem boundary
warning_code_taxonomy.public_copy: Open-problem boundary: route inspection only; no solution, proof closure, or external peer review is claimed.

warning_code_taxonomy.label: Inspectability score is not proof closure
warning_code_taxonomy.applies_when: target row is a standard boundary/obligation row without elevated open-problem handling
warning_code_taxonomy.public_copy: Boundary inspectability score only; displayed decimals do not represent proof sufficiency or proof closure.

taxonomy.label: Open-problem proof boundary
taxonomy.applies_when: target row is famous, conjecture/problem/question-styled, or otherwise requires an elevated open-problem boundary
taxonomy.public_copy: Open-problem boundary: route inspection only; no solution, proof closure, or external peer review is claimed.

taxonomy.label: Inspectability score is not proof closure
taxonomy.applies_when: target row is a standard boundary/obligation row without elevated open-problem handling
taxonomy.public_copy: Boundary inspectability score only; displayed decimals do not represent proof sufficiency or proof closure.

warning_code_reconciliation.legacy_alias_policy: Legacy warning_code values are accepted only through aliases and are exported as canonical_warning_code.

why_counts_can_differ: Replay-backed evidence routes are inspection/replay rows and do not automatically become public proof-closed rows.
Obligation and boundary rows are explicitly excluded from proof closure even when they carry hashes and route bodies.
Terminal or retired rows remain inventory rows, not proof closure rows.
proof_count_scope_reconciliation.decision_point_copy: Proof closed count is scoped to proof-closed excluding obligations; replay-backed route count is evidence inventory.

proof_graph_body_route_count_reconciliat.graph_body_policy: Graph proof/boundary nodes are navigation anchors; proof_body_index rows are the authoritative public route/body inventory.
proof_graph_body_route_count_reconciliat.count_mismatch_policy: A graph/body count mismatch is allowed only when graph nodes aggregate routes or expose boundary anchors; it must not change proof-closed totals.
proof_graph_body_route_count_reconciliat.nonclaim_boundary: Count reconciliation proves inventory consistency only, not proof closure.

proof_carrying_hash_lineage.export_hash_scope: selected route plus visible source/boundary packet

evidence_score_summary.formula_payload_alignment: b_i(c) terms are the named score_component_basis contributions; raw_weighted_score is their component_total for boundary rows; capped_score/evidence_score applies kappa_c.
evidence_score_summary.score_kind: BOUNDARY_INSPECTABILITY_SCORE_NOT_PROOF unless a row is explicitly proof-closed excluding obligations
evidence_score_summary.proof_score_policy: All current rows are boundary/obligation inspectability rows; no displayed score is proof progress or proof closure.
